mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice (invoice_no, company_id, customer_id, order_id, order_no, invoice_type, invoice_date, total_amount, tax_rate, file_url, status, remark) VALUES (#{invoiceNo}, #{companyId}, #{customerId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{invoiceType}, #{invoiceDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{taxRate}, #{fileUrl}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, c.customer_name FROM invoice i LEFT JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE i.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM invoice WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN so.total_amount - IFNULL(inv.invoiced, 0) > 0 THEN so.total_amount - IFNULL(inv.invoiced, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(total_amount) AS invoiced FROM invoice WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY order_id ) inv ON so.id = inv.order_id WHERE so.company_id = #{companyId} AND so.customer_id = #{customerId} AND so.status = 1
